claim: A January 2025 Tamil Guardian report said checkpoints removed after the 2024 change of government had been reinstalled at Pannai, Mukamalai, Mandaithivu and Eluthumadduval; the UK Home Office later found no independent corroborating source for that specific reinstatement report.
bounded_by: The report traces to one Tamil-nationalist source family and is explicitly uncorroborated in the UK Home Office synthesis.
notes: Preserves the event as a bounded report rather than laundering it into a confirmed policy reversal.
